_metadata.author: CreativeWorkzStudio LLC / ProfessorSeanEX
_metadata.role: Root data manifest acting as the master menu for all data-driven game subsystems.
invariants: All registered subsystem paths must point to valid subdirectories containing their own manifest.json
Subsystem identifiers must be unique across the entire data catalog
Strict conformance to the OmniCode 5-Block Ontological Architecture

subsystems.title: Logging & Diagnostic Telemetry Subsystem
subsystems.description: Log runtime configurations, telemetry depth, and console output settings.

subsystems.title: Mathematical Continuum & Invariant Subsystem
subsystems.description: Resonance limits, moral sway continuum, equilibrium bands, and HUD scaling.

subsystems.title: Monotonic Timing & Frame Pacing Subsystem
subsystems.description: 60/120 FPS frame budgets, simulation turn latency, and monotonic clock.

subsystems.title: Lexical Buffer & Command Tokens Subsystem
subsystems.description: Buffer limits, stance tokens, and canonical action verb dictionaries.

subsystems.title: Interactive Engine Debugger & State Rewind Subsystem
subsystems.description: State snapshots, time-travel rewind, breakpoint watchpoints, tripwire traps, and trace telemetry.

subsystems.title: Combat Classes & Growth Subsystem
subsystems.description: Basic classes (Warrior, Mage, Rogue), first upgrade Priest, advanced classes, NPC guards, and summons.

subsystems.title: Protagonists, Companions & Adversaries
subsystems.description: Elijah, Katrina (ex-Mage Rogue), Observer custom bearer, Sebastien, Angela, and bestiary.

subsystems.title: Tactical Combat & Stance Mechanics
subsystems.description: Grid formations, action point economy, and relic stance transitions.

subsystems.title: Twin Relics Continuum (Lux & Tenebris)
subsystems.description: Shield of Lux and Sword of Tenebris resonance thresholds and affinity curves.

subsystems.title: Kingdom of Sacyra & Dreamscape Topology
subsystems.description: Regional node graph, travel vigor consumption, and realm threat tiers.
